scripts.package: NODE_ENV=production node build.mjs && cd dist && rm -f ../jobhakken-extension.zip && zip -qr ../jobhakken-extension.zip . && cd .. && echo "packaged → jobhakken-extension.zip (upload this to the Chrome Web Store)"
scripts.test:e2e: E2E=1 npm run build && playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:headed: E2E=1 npm run build && PWHEAD=1 playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:ui: E2E=1 npm run build && playwright test --ui
scripts.test:live: E2E=1 npm run build && LIVE=1 playwright test e2e/live/smoke.spec.ts
scripts.capture:har: E2E=1 npm run build && CAPTURE=1 playwright test e2e/tools/capture-har.spec.ts
scripts.smoke: E2E=1 npm run build && playwright test e2e/goldens.spec.ts
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run check:permissions && npm run build && npm test
scripts.capture:static: E2E=1 npm run build && CAPTURE=1 playwright test e2e/tools/capture-static.spec.ts
scripts.verify:live: E2E=1 npm run build && VERIFY=1 playwright test e2e/tools/verify-live.spec.ts
